Explanatory Notes: This chart represents MAID deaths where the report was received by Health Canada by January 31, 2022. For 2021, this represents 9,950 MAID deaths, including non-RFND and self administration. Practitioners were able to identify more than one method they used to arrive at this conclusion, therefore totals exceed 100%.
